# Nepal License Checker
> Instantly check if your Nepal smart card driving license has been printed and is ready for collection from the Department of Transport Management (DOTM).

## Who is this for?
Nepali citizens who have applied for a smart card driving license and want to know if it's ready to collect from their transport office.

## Key features
- Free, no sign-up required
- Bilingual: English and Nepali (नेपाली)
- Data sourced directly from DOTM official PDF lists
- Live lookup against 100,000+ indexed records
- Updates weekly in sync with DOTM publication schedule

## How to use
Enter your license number in format XX-XX-XXXXXXXX (Office-District-Number) and press Check Status. Example: 01-01-12345678.

## Links
- Homepage: https://license-checker.acharyanischal.com.np
- Check license: https://license-checker.acharyanischal.com.np/?number=XX-XX-XXXXXXXX
- Official source: https://dotm.gov.np/category/details-of-printed-licenses/
- Developer: https://acharyanischal.com.np
